children: Zhou Jun, former president of China's Shanghai Industrial Investment (Holdings) Company Limited (SIIC), was sentenced to the death penalty with a two-year reprieve due to corruption, a Shanghai court ruled on Friday.
His sentence will be commuted to life in prison unless he commits crimes during the two-year reprieve period.
